remarks: Beautifully updated 3-bedroom colonial with oversized 2-car garage & ample parking: Welcome home! This charming and beautifully updated single-family Colonial offers the space, privacy, and convenience you've been looking for. Ideally situated on a fabulous corner lot, this inviting home features a welcoming front porch, level backyard, rear deck, oversized two-car garage, and off-street parking for up to six additional vehicles.  The main level offers a thoughtfully updated kitchen, remodeled living room with a cozy fireplace and built-ins, and a spacious dining room with double doors opening to the rear deck. A full bathroom with shower and convenient laundry area complete the first floor.  Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms and a beautifully remodeled full bathroom featuring a tub and double vanity.  With stylish updates, comfortable living space, exceptional parking, a two-car garage, and wonderful outdoor areas, this move-in-ready home is ready for its next residents: Simply unpack and settle in! Bonus pull down stairs lead to spacious attic, ideal for storing all your seasonal items!
